reviewer: Codex attendance_review source author; not human or subject-matter approval
method: Direct original publisher page opens, followed by independent HTTP 200 retrieval of the original Oxford HTML. Oxford rendered selected topic labels, public sense-element attributes and unrelated footer labels are recorded separately. Only original summaries, minimal attribute identifiers and body hashes are retained; no source pages, media or exercises are imported.

consultations.selected_section: Verb sense 1, finish making/doing; rendered lines 112-140
consultations.selected_sense: Bringing work or an activity to its end.
consultations.other_senses: Oxford explicitly separates form filling as sense 2 (complete_sng_7, cefr=a1) and making a whole set as sense 3 (complete_sng_8, cefr=a2). The draft's form example must not be treated as proof that these are one dictionary sense.
consultations.unrelated_footer: The rendered B2 label belongs to the Word of the Day reasonably, not complete.
consultations.supports: A narrow finishing definition and a task-completion example. A2 remains an editorial course-floor placement despite Oxford selected A1 metadata.
consultations.limits: No form-filling, make-whole, adjective, morphology, media, expression or specialist approval. The old pending form-image brief remains a separate mismatch to resolve before picture acceptance.

consultations.selected_section: COBUILD verb sense 8, rendered lines 299-306; adjacent sense 9 at 315-321
consultations.selected_sense: Finishing the work of making or doing something.
consultations.other_senses: The source separately labels doing all of an activity A2 and form/questionnaire filling in sense 10 A2. Equal levels do not merge the meanings. Its adjective and complete-set senses are separate.
consultations.supports: Supports editorial A2 and a finishing-work example.
consultations.limits: The retained source distinction requires narrowing the draft rather than silently treating form filling as the same selected sense.

consultations.selected_section: Verb sense 1, making something/somebody ready, rendered lines 114-142
consultations.selected_sense: Making a thing ready for its intended use or event; the source includes a room being readied.
consultations.other_senses: Self-preparation, food preparation and chemical/medicine manufacture are separate entries. The Cooking and eating A1 topic label belongs to the food sense.
consultations.unrelated_footer: The rendered B2 footer labels reasonably, not prepare.
consultations.supports: The existing room-for-visitors definition/example align with ordinary transitive readying.
consultations.limits: No food handling, medicine manufacture, specialist preparation procedure or active mastery certification.

consultations.selected_sense: Making something ready for an expected use or event.
consultations.other_senses: Self/event preparation with for or an infinitive is separately B1; food preparation is separately A2.
consultations.supports: Supports retaining the original room example and editorial A2 while recording Oxford's selected A1 metadata.
consultations.limits: The B1 self-preparation label is not assigned to the selected transitive object-readying example.

consultations.selected_section: Verb sense 1, planning/organizing in advance, rendered lines 112-175
consultations.selected_sense: Planning the details of an event or making arrangements for it.
consultations.other_senses: Putting physical objects in order is sense 2; adapting music is sense 3. Neither is the selected supplier-meeting sense.
consultations.unrelated_footer: The rendered B2 footer labels reasonably, not arrange.
consultations.supports: Retaining the existing meeting-planning definition/example and editorial A2 is supported by selected-sense metadata.
consultations.limits: Record the Collins selected B1 disagreement. This is not unanimous certification and does not accept physical arranging or all arrange-for expressions.

consultations.selected_section: COBUILD verb sense 1 event/meeting planning, rendered lines 224-233
consultations.selected_sense: Making plans so an event or meeting will occur.
consultations.other_senses: Making plans with another person and arranging access/services are adjacent B1 senses; positioning objects is separately B2; music adaptation is separate.
consultations.supports: Confirms the existing supplier-meeting meaning and natural usage.
consultations.limits: Literal B1 remains a source disagreement with the proposed A2 placement and Oxford A2 metadata. No level is borrowed from the separate positioning sense.

consultations.selected_section: Pickup/take-away sense 4, rendered lines 160-175; contrast gathering sense 1 at 113-122
consultations.selected_sense: Taking an item away from a place where it is ready for pickup; includes keys at reception.
consultations.other_senses: Gathering things from people/places is sense 1 with cefr=a2; hobby collecting is separately A2; accumulation and soliciting money are separate B1 senses.
consultations.regional_scope: Oxford marks its person-pickup examples British English; the object/package/reception examples in the same sense are not individually region-labelled.
consultations.unrelated_footer: The rendered B2 footer labels reasonably, not collect.
consultations.supports: The existing example/image brief and Foundation02 expression assess pickup, while the draft definition also includes gathering.
consultations.limits: Hold the entire live entry unchanged pending an independent selected-sense and region decision. The stable gather ID is not permission to merge the two dictionary meanings or change scored contexts.

consultations.selected_section: COBUILD verb sense 3 pickup, rendered lines 244-250
consultations.selected_sense: Going to get a person or thing from the place where it is waiting or was left.
consultations.regional_scope: The selected COBUILD pickup sense is explicitly labelled British, including its person-or-thing definition.
consultations.other_senses: Gathering, hobby collecting, receiving money, telephone charges and the prayer noun are not selected.
consultations.supports: Supports pickup meaning while exposing a broader regional label than Oxford's person-example labels.
consultations.limits: No automatic region relabeling or B1/A2 reconciliation. Preserve the current general-region record and all assessment bytes until independent decision.

consultations.selected_sense: Taking physical goods or letters to their intended recipient/destination.
consultations.rendered_label_scope: Shopping topic attached to selected sense 1.

consultations.unrelated_footer: The rendered B2 footer labels reasonably, not the selected transport sense.
consultations.supports: Narrow the draft to tangible items, retain the courier/parcel example, and propose editorial B1.
consultations.limits: No information transmission, speech, service-performance, clinical, legal or expression approval.
